[P3] Document the actual core completion-delivery contract

Core does not implement either guarantee stated here: invocation Start supplies snapshots without emitting terminal hooks, and `on_operation_update` forwards repeated terminal observations. The new `test_repeated_checkpoint_observations_each_reach_plugins` explicitly expects two deliveries. Plugin authors relying on this docstring would miss skipped descendants or duplicate exports. Describe snapshot processing and deduplication as plugin responsibilities, matching the updated README.
